description: A new version of an artifact a member made (agents’ work is revised with artifact_feedback): the same kinds of input as create_artifact, or `content` alone; it keeps its type. `base_version` guards against overwriting someone else’s newer version. The result has `app_url`.

html.description: a whole HTML page (up to 2 MB), titled from its <title>

markdown.description: markdown: `---`-separated slides become a deck, under 300 words a note, else a report

media_ids.description: finished Studio media: one video, or 1–12 images

type.description: an artifact type (with `content`), checked against its schema

upload_id.description: a finished file you uploaded (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, image, .md, .html, .csv)

name: revise_artifact
title: Revise your artifact
